records.label: spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner.shutdown#1
records.source: Call from ``closeEvent``. Qt aborts the process if a running QThread is destroyed, so a bounded wait is needed when a screen closes mid-load. ``timeout_ms`` is shared by every thread of this runner. Threads that outlast it are parked by :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.drain_thread` rather than terminated.
records.context: Call from ``closeEvent``. Qt aborts the process if an executing QThread is destroyed, so a bounded wait is needed when an application view closes mid-load. ``timeout_ms`` is shared by every independent execution path of this runner. Independent execution paths that outlast it are parked by :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.drain_thread` rather than terminated.
records.translation: 从 ``closeEvent`` 调用。如果正在运行的 QThread 被销毁，Qt 会中止整个进程，因此在界面于加载过程中关闭时需要有时限的等待。此运行器的所有线程共用 ``timeout_ms``。超过该时间的线程由 :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.drain_thread` 保留，而不是被强制终止。
records.review_basis: Exact-source technical correction: old shutdown paragraph omitted the shared timeout_ms contract; the shutdown_all timeout parameter was absent from every old locale body.
